body:
[DTM + CTW] Sirroco by Ehlf

So on this map I've taken some inspiration of other maps like Halcyon, Rendezvous, Wahiz etc.
Hope you like it! :D

Author: Ehlf (Sam)
Map Name: Sirroco
Teams: Magenta vs Green
Team Size: Max 18v18, Min 2v2
Objectives: 2 Monuments, 2 Wools
Images: http://imgur.com/a/iruRa
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/tso7qaukmzped1x/Sirroco.zip
XML: Soon
Kill Reward (For XML Creator): 1 Gapple, 4xp bottles + the loot that drops from the person you kill. (Not sword, pickaxe, bow and armor)
Wools: 
Team Magenta:
Blue and Yellow
Team Green:
Red and Cyan
Build Time: About 6-7 Hours

-Thanks!

Sam
